sw.L: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Yatosha, enyi wakuu wa Israeli! Ondoeni ukatili na unyang'anyi, mkatende hukumu na haki; acheni kuwafukuza watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Yatosha, enyi wakuu wa Israeli! Komesheni ukatili na unyang'anyi, mtende yaliyo ya haki na adili. Acheni kuwafukuza watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} katika ardhi yao, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Enyi watawala wa Israeli, mmetenda mabaya ya kutosha! Acheni ukatili wenu na wizi wenu. Tendeni yaliyo ya haki na mema. Acheni kuwalazimisha watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kuondoka katika ardhi yao, anasema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.

ko.L: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 이스라엘의 군주들아, 이제 그만하면 되었다! 폭력과 파괴를 치우고, 정의와 의를 행하여라. 내 백성을 쫓아내는 일을 그쳐라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 이스라엘의 군주들아, 이제 그만하여라! 폭력과 파괴를 그치고, 정의와 의를 행하여라. 내 백성을 그들의 땅에서 쫓아내는 일을 멈추어라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.
ko.R: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 이스라엘의 통치자들아, 너희는 악한 짓을 할 만큼 했다! 폭력과 강탈을 그만두어라. 옳고 바른 일을 하여라. 내 백성을 그들의 땅에서 억지로 쫓아내는 일을 멈추어라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.

am.L: ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ የእስራኤል ገዦች ሆይ፣ ይበቃችኋል! ግፍንና ጥፋትን አስወግዱ፤ ፍትሕንና ጽድቅንም አድርጉ፤ ማፈናቀላችሁን ከሕዝቤ ላይ አንሡ፤ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.B: ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ እናንተ የእስራኤል ገዦች፣ ይበቃል! ግፍንና ጥፋትን አቁሙ፤ ትክክልና ቅን የሆነውን አድርጉ። ሕዝቤን ከመሬቱ ማፈናቀላችሁን ተዉ፤ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ እናንተ የእስራኤል ገዦች፣ ያደረጋችሁት ክፋት ይበቃል! ግፍንና ዘረፋን አቁሙ። ትክክልና ፍትሐዊ የሆነውን አድርጉ። ሕዝቤን ከመሬቱ ማባረራችሁን ተዉ፤ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: हे इस्राएल के प्रधानो, बस करो! उपद्रव और विनाश को दूर करो, और न्याय और धार्मिकता के काम करो; मेरी प्रजा पर से अपनी बेदख़लियाँ हटा लो, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.B: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: हे इस्राएल के प्रधानो, बस करो! हिंसा और विनाश का अंत करो, और वह करो जो न्यायसंगत और उचित है। मेरी प्रजा को उनकी भूमि से निकालना बंद करो, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.R: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: हे इस्राएल के शासको, तुम बहुत बुराई कर चुके! अपनी हिंसा और लूटपाट बंद करो। वह करो जो उचित और सही है। मेरी प्रजा को उनकी भूमि से ज़बरदस्ती निकालना बंद करो, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: Так говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Довольно вам, князья Израиля! Насилие и грабёж отбросьте, и правосудие и праведность творите; прекратите ваши выселения {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} народа, — слово Владыки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Так говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Довольно, князья Израиля! Покончите с насилием и грабежом и поступайте справедливо и праведно. Перестаньте сгонять {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ с его земли, — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Вот что говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Правители Израиля, хватит вам творить зло! Прекратите насилие и грабёж. Поступайте честно и правильно. Перестаньте выгонять {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ с его земли, — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

uk.L: Так говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Досить, князі Ізраїлю! Відкиньте насильство і грабіж, і чиніть правосуддя і праведність; припиніть ваше виганяння {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} народу, говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Так говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Досить, князі Ізраїлю! Покладіть край насильству і грабежу і чиніть те, що справедливе й правильне. Перестаньте зганяти {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ з його землі, говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Так говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Ви, правителі Ізраїлю, вчинили досить зла! Припиніть насильство і грабунок. Чиніть те, що чесне й правильне. Перестаньте зганяти {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ з його землі, каже Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: your evictions: driving people off their land
decisions.reason: The word means expulsion. It describes the seizing of family land by the powerful, which the law forbade (Leviticus 25:23; Micah 2:2; Isaiah 5:8).

decisions.choice: justice and righteousness: the standard for kings
decisions.reason: The pair describes the right rule of a king (2 Samuel 8:15; Jeremiah 22:3, 15; 23:5).

decisions.choice: justice and righteousness (L); what is just and right (B); what is fair and right (R)
decisions.reason: Readable follows the Amos table for this pair ("what is right").

decisions.choice: driving my people off their land (B); forcing my people off their land (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "evictions". Balanced and Readable say what was done (m1).

decisions.choice: "el derecho y la justicia" (L); "lo que es justo y recto" (B); "lo que es justo y correcto" (R); plural_you to the princes
decisions.reason: Mishpat and tsedaqah follow the Spanish note for the prophets ("derecho" / "justicia"), with B and R saying what they mean, as the English does. The princes are addressed as a group.

decisions.choice: "công lý và sự công chính" (L) / "điều công minh và chính trực" (B) / "điều công bằng và ngay thẳng" (R)
decisions.reason: The pair mishpat and tsedaqah, worded at Literal as in the Isaiah note and at Balanced and Readable as the English B and R put it; the princes are rebuked as "các ngươi".

decisions.choice: hukumu na haki (Literal); yaliyo ya haki na adili (Balanced); yaliyo ya haki na mema (Readable)
decisions.reason: Mishpat and tsedaqah, the standard for rulers (meaning decision); Literal keeps the paired nouns of the Isaiah note, Balanced and Readable say what is just and right.

decisions.choice: "정의와 의" (L, B); "옳고 바른 일" (R)
decisions.reason: The pair as Isaiah and Jeremiah settled it in Korean, so the standard for kings reads the same across the prophets.

decisions.choice: अपनी बेदख़लियाँ हटा लो (L); उनकी भूमि से निकालना बंद करो (B, R)
decisions.reason: The evictions are the driving of people off their land (m1). Literal keeps the noun (बेदख़ली, eviction); Balanced and Readable say what was done, as the English does.

decisions.choice: выселения (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the noun "evictions" but not изгнание, which in Ezekiel is the exile; Balanced and Readable say what was done (m1).

source.text: מֹֽאזְנֵי־צֶ֧דֶק וְאֵֽיפַת־צֶ֛דֶק וּבַת־צֶ֖דֶק יְהִ֥י לָכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Balances of righteousness and an ephah of righteousness and a bath of righteousness let there be for you.

en.L: You will have honest scales, an honest ephah and an honest bath.
en.B: You are to use honest scales, an honest ephah and an honest bath.
en.R: You must use honest scales and honest measures for grain and for liquids.

pt.L: Vocês terão balanças justas, um efa justo e um bato justo.
pt.B: Vocês deverão usar balanças exatas, um efa exato e um bato exato.
pt.R: Vocês devem usar balanças honestas e medidas honestas para cereais e para líquidos.

es.L: Balanzas justas, efa justo y bato justo {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Usarán|Usaréis}} balanzas exactas, un efa exacto y un bato exacto.
es.R: {{plural_you:Tienen|Tenéis}} que usar balanzas exactas y medidas exactas para el grano y para los líquidos.

fr.L: Vous aurez des balances justes, un épha juste et un bath juste.
fr.B: Vous aurez des balances exactes, un épha exact et un bath exact.
fr.R: Vous devez utiliser des balances honnêtes et des mesures honnêtes pour les grains et pour les liquides.

vi.L: Các ngươi sẽ có cân công chính, ê-pha công chính và bát công chính.
vi.B: Các ngươi phải dùng cân đúng, ê-pha đúng và bát đúng.
vi.R: Các ngươi phải dùng cân đúng và đồ đong ngũ cốc, đồ đong chất lỏng cho đúng.

sw.L: Mtakuwa na mizani ya haki, na efa ya haki, na bathi ya haki.
sw.B: Mtatumia mizani ya haki, efa ya haki na bathi ya haki.
sw.R: Lazima mtumie mizani ya haki, na vipimo vya haki vya nafaka na vya vitu vya majimaji.

ko.L: 너희에게는 바른 저울과 바른 에바와 바른 밧이 있어야 한다.
ko.B: 너희는 정확한 저울과 정확한 에바와 정확한 밧을 써야 한다.
ko.R: 너희는 정확한 저울과, 곡식을 되는 정확한 되와 액체를 되는 정확한 되를 써야 한다.

am.L: ትክክለኛ ሚዛን፣ ትክክለኛ ኢፍ፣ ትክክለኛም ባዶስ ይኑራችሁ።
am.B: ትክክለኛ ሚዛን፣ ትክክለኛ ኢፍና ትክክለኛ ባዶስ ተጠቀሙ።
am.R: ትክክለኛ ሚዛንና ለእህልም ለፈሳሽም ትክክለኛ መስፈሪያ ተጠቀሙ።

hi.L: तुम्हारे पास सच्चे तराज़ू, सच्चा एपा और सच्चा बत हो।
hi.B: तुम सच्चे तराज़ू, सच्चा एपा और सच्चा बत काम में लाना।
hi.R: तुम्हें सच्चे तराज़ू, और अनाज और तरल चीज़ों के लिए सच्चे नाप काम में लाने हैं।

ru.L: Весы правды, и ефа правды, и бат правды пусть будут у вас.
ru.B: Пусть у вас будут честные весы, честная ефа и честный бат.
ru.R: Пользуйтесь честными весами и честными мерами для зерна и для жидкостей.

uk.L: Ви матимете чесні терези, чесну ефу і чесний бат.
uk.B: Ви маєте користуватися чесними терезами, чесною ефою і чесним батом.
uk.R: Ви мусите користуватися чесними терезами і чесними мірами для зерна і для рідин.

decisions.choice: the ephah and the bath: the standard measures for grain and for liquids
decisions.reason: The ephah measured dry goods such as flour and grain; the bath measured liquids such as oil and wine. Dishonest measures were a common way of cheating (Amos 8:5; Micah 6:10-11; Leviticus 19:35-36).

decisions.choice: of righteousness: honest, true
decisions.reason: The phrase "balances of righteousness" means scales that weigh truly (Leviticus 19:36).

decisions.choice: an ephah, a bath (L, B); measures for grain and for liquids (R)
decisions.reason: Here the measures themselves are the subject, so Literal and Balanced keep their names without a modern equivalent. Readable says what they measured; their size is given in verse 11.

decisions.choice: um efa, um bato (L, B); medidas para cereais e para líquidos (R)
decisions.reason: The names of the measures as Leviticus 19:36 and 1 Kings 7:26 give them in Portuguese ("efa", "batos"), here without a metric equivalent since the measures themselves are the subject, as the English; Readable says what they measured.

decisions.choice: "efa" and "bato" (L, B); "medidas ... para el grano y para los líquidos" (R)
decisions.reason: The published Spanish names these measures "efa" and "bato" (1 Samuel 1:24; Isaiah 5:10).

decisions.choice: "ê-pha" and "bát" named at Literal and Balanced; "đồ đong ngũ cốc, đồ đong chất lỏng" at Readable
decisions.reason: The published names of the two measures ("ê-pha", and "bát" as in 1 Kings 7:26); Readable says what they measured, as the English R does.

decisions.choice: efa, bathi (Literal, Balanced); vipimo vya nafaka / vya vitu vya majimaji (Readable)
decisions.reason: The published names of the two measures; Readable says what they measured, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "ኢፍ", "ባዶስ" (L, B); "ለእህልም ለፈሳሽም ... መስፈሪያ" (R)
decisions.reason: The ephah and the bath keep the names used on main (Leviticus, Numbers, 1 Kings): ኢፍ and ባዶስ; the homer is ሆሜር, the kor ቆሮስ, the hin ኢን, the shekel ሰቅል, the gerah ጌራ and the mina ምናን. Readable names what they measure, as the English does.

decisions.choice: एपा, बत (L, B); अनाज और तरल चीज़ों के नाप (R)
decisions.reason: The measures themselves are the subject here (m1), so Literal and Balanced keep their names, एपा and बत, as Leviticus and 1 Kings spell them, with no metric value (the English has no units span); Readable says what they measured, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: весы правды (L); честные (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew genitive "of righteousness"; Balanced and Readable say what it means (m2). Ефа and бат are the measures' names in the Russian Pentateuch and Kings.

source.text: הָאֵיפָ֣ה וְהַבַּ֗ת תֹּ֤כֶן אֶחָד֙ יִֽהְיֶ֔ה לָשֵׂ֕את מַעְשַׂ֥ר הַחֹ֖מֶר הַבָּ֑ת וַעֲשִׂירִ֤ת הַחֹ֨מֶר֙ הָֽאֵיפָ֔ה אֶל־הַחֹ֖מֶר יִהְיֶ֥ה מַתְכֻּנְתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: The ephah and the bath one measure will be, to contain a tenth of the homer the bath, and a tenth of the homer the ephah; according to the homer will be its measure.

en.L: The ephah and the bath will be one measure, the bath holding a tenth of the homer, and the ephah a tenth of the homer; its measure will be according to the homer.
en.B: The ephah and the bath are to be the same size, the bath holding {{units:about 6 gallons|a tenth of a homer}} and the ephah {{units:about 6 gallons|a tenth of a homer}}. The homer is to be the standard for both.
en.R: The measure for grain and the measure for liquids must be the same size. Each one must hold {{units:about 6 gallons|a tenth of a homer}}. The homer is the standard for both.

pt.L: O efa e o bato serão de uma [só] medida, o bato contendo a décima parte do hômer, e o efa a décima parte do hômer; a sua medida será segundo o hômer.
pt.B: O efa e o bato deverão ter o mesmo tamanho: o bato conterá {{units:cerca de 22 litros|a décima parte de um hômer}}, e o efa, {{units:cerca de 22 litros|a décima parte de um hômer}}. O hômer será o padrão para os dois.
pt.R: A medida para cereais e a medida para líquidos devem ter o mesmo tamanho. Cada uma deve conter {{units:cerca de 22 litros|a décima parte de um hômer}}. O hômer é o padrão para as duas.

es.L: El efa y el bato serán una misma medida, conteniendo el bato la décima parte del homer, y el efa la décima parte del homer; según el homer será su medida.
es.B: El efa y el bato serán del mismo tamaño: el bato contendrá {{units:unos 22 litros|la décima parte de un homer}}, y el efa, {{units:unos 22 litros|la décima parte de un homer}}. El homer será la medida patrón para ambos.
es.R: La medida para el grano y la medida para los líquidos tienen que ser del mismo tamaño. Cada una tiene que contener {{units:unos 22 litros|la décima parte de un homer}}. El homer es la medida patrón para las dos.

fr.L: L’épha et le bath seront une seule mesure, le bath contenant le dixième du homer, et l’épha le dixième du homer ; sa mesure sera d’après le homer.
fr.B: L’épha et le bath auront la même capacité : le bath contiendra {{units:environ 22 litres|un dixième de homer}}, et l’épha {{units:environ 22 litres|un dixième de homer}}. Le homer servira d’étalon pour les deux.
fr.R: La mesure pour les grains et la mesure pour les liquides doivent avoir la même taille. Chacune doit contenir {{units:environ 22 litres|un dixième de homer}}. Le homer sert d’étalon pour les deux.

vi.L: Ê-pha và bát sẽ cùng một cỡ đo, bát chứa một phần mười hô-me, và ê-pha một phần mười hô-me; cỡ đo của nó sẽ theo hô-me.
vi.B: Ê-pha và bát phải cùng một cỡ: bát chứa {{units:khoảng 22 lít|một phần mười hô-me}} và ê-pha cũng chứa {{units:khoảng 22 lít|một phần mười hô-me}}. Hô-me sẽ là chuẩn cho cả hai.
vi.R: Đồ đong ngũ cốc và đồ đong chất lỏng phải cùng một cỡ. Mỗi thứ phải chứa {{units:khoảng 22 lít|một phần mười hô-me}}. Hô-me là chuẩn cho cả hai.

sw.L: Efa na bathi zitakuwa kipimo kimoja, bathi ikichukua sehemu ya kumi ya homeri, na efa sehemu ya kumi ya homeri; kipimo chake kitakuwa kufuatana na homeri.
sw.B: Efa na bathi zitakuwa za ukubwa mmoja: bathi itachukua {{units:karibu lita 22|sehemu ya kumi ya homeri}} na efa {{units:karibu lita 22|sehemu ya kumi ya homeri}}. Homeri itakuwa kipimo cha msingi cha zote mbili.
sw.R: Kipimo cha nafaka na kipimo cha vitu vya majimaji lazima viwe vya ukubwa mmoja. Kila kimoja kichukue {{units:karibu lita 22|sehemu ya kumi ya homeri}}. Homeri ni kipimo cha msingi cha vyote viwili.

ko.L: 에바와 밧은 한 가지 양이 될 것이니, 밧은 호멜의 십분의 일을 담고 에바도 호멜의 십분의 일을 담는다. 그 양은 호멜을 기준으로 할 것이다.
ko.B: 에바와 밧은 같은 크기여야 한다. 밧의 용량은 {{units:약 22리터|호멜의 십분의 일}}이고, 에바의 용량도 {{units:약 22리터|호멜의 십분의 일}}이다. 호멜이 두 되의 기준이 된다.
ko.R: 곡식을 되는 되와 액체를 되는 되는 크기가 같아야 한다. 둘 다 용량이 {{units:약 22리터여야|호멜의 십분의 일이어야}} 한다. 호멜이 두 되의 기준이다.

am.L: ኢፉና ባዶሱ አንድ መጠን ይሁኑ፤ ባዶሱ የሆሜርን አንድ አሥረኛ፣ ኢፉም የሆሜርን አንድ አሥረኛ ይይዛል፤ መጠኑ በሆሜር ይሆናል።
am.B: ኢፉና ባዶሱ መጠናቸው እኩል ይሁን፤ ባዶሱ {{units:22 ሊትር ያህል|የሆሜር አንድ አሥረኛ}}፣ ኢፉም {{units:22 ሊትር ያህል|የሆሜር አንድ አሥረኛ}} ይያዝ። ለሁለቱም መለኪያው ሆሜር ይሁን።
am.R: የእህል መስፈሪያውና የፈሳሽ መስፈሪያው መጠናቸው እኩል መሆን አለበት። እያንዳንዳቸው {{units:22 ሊትር ያህል|የሆሜር አንድ አሥረኛ}} ይያዙ። ለሁለቱም መለኪያው ሆሜር ነው።

hi.L: एपा और बत एक ही नाप के हों, कि बत में होमेर का दसवाँ भाग समाए, और एपा में होमेर का दसवाँ भाग; उनका नाप होमेर के अनुसार हो।
hi.B: एपा और बत एक ही माप के हों: बत में {{units:लगभग 22 लीटर|होमेर का दसवाँ भाग}} समाए और एपा में भी {{units:लगभग 22 लीटर|होमेर का दसवाँ भाग}}। दोनों का मानक होमेर हो।

ru.L: Ефа и бат будут одной меры: бату вмещать десятую часть хомера, и десятую часть хомера — ефе; по хомеру будет их мера.
ru.B: Ефа и бат должны быть одного размера: бат вмещает {{units:около 22 литров|десятую часть хомера}}, и ефа — {{units:около 22 литров|десятую часть хомера}}. Мерой для обоих пусть будет хомер.

uk.L: Ефа і бат будуть однієї міри, щоб бат містив десяту частину хомера, і ефа — десяту частину хомера; їхня міра буде за хомером.
uk.B: Ефа і бат мають бути однакові: бат містить {{units:близько 22 літрів|десяту частину хомера}}, і ефа — {{units:близько 22 літрів|десяту частину хомера}}. Хомер має бути мірилом для обох.
uk.R: Міра для зерна і міра для рідин мусять бути однакові. Кожна має містити {{units:близько 22 літрів|десяту частину хомера}}. Хомер — мірило для обох.

decisions.choice: the ephah and the bath of one size: about 6 gallons each
decisions.reason: The verse makes the dry measure (ephah) and the liquid measure (bath) equal, each a tenth of the homer. Ancient measures varied from place to place and over time, and modern estimates differ widely: the bath is reckoned at about 6 gallons (22 liters), and the ephah at anything from about half a bushel to about two-thirds of a bushel. The published books of this translation give an ephah as about 20 quarts; in Ezekiel, where the text sets the two measures equal, both are given as about 6 gallons, and a homer as ten of them (about 60 gallons, or about 6 bushels of grain).

decisions.choice: the homer: the largest measure, ten ephahs or ten baths
decisions.reason: The name may mean "a donkey load". It was the same as the kor (verse 14).

decisions.choice: {{units:about 6 gallons|a tenth of a homer}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: In Ezekiel 45-46 the ephah and the bath are both given as about 6 gallons, since the text sets them equal (m1).

decisions.choice: the measure for grain and the measure for liquids (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 10.

decisions.choice: {{units:cerca de 22 litros|a décima parte de um hômer}}

decisions.reason: Verse 11 makes the ephah and the bath the same size, so in Ezekiel both are given one figure, as the founder's ruling for the English sets, and the homer is ten of them, about 220 litres, as the published Isaiah 5:10.

decisions.choice: litres by default in chapters 45-46: an ephah or a bath {{units:environ 22 litres|un épha}}, a homer or kor about 220 litres, a hin and a sixth of an ephah about 4 litres, a tenth of a bath about 2 litres; shekels in grams (about 11,5 g each)
alternatives: US gallons and quarts as the English
decisions.reason: The values of the term sheet and the published Pentateuch; French has no conflict here, since the published French ephah is already about 22 litres, the English "about 6 gallons".

decisions.choice: "khoảng 22 lít" for a tenth of a homer, the ephah and the bath alike; the homer about 220 litres
decisions.reason: The founder's ruling for Ezekiel gives one figure for the ephah and the bath; the published Vietnamese ephah and bath are both about 22 litres, so the figure is the same, and the homer ("hô-me") and the kor ("cô-rơ") are ten of them.

decisions.choice: {{units:karibu lita 22|sehemu ya kumi ya homeri}} for both the ephah and the bath
decisions.reason: As the founder's ruling for the English, one figure serves for both measures, and Swahili keeps the 22 litres the published Swahili already gives an ephah; a homer or kor is about 220 litres.

decisions.choice: Ephah and bath both {{units:약 22리터|...}}; homer and kor 약 220리터; hin 약 3.7리터

Korean uses the figure the published Korean Pentateuch and Ezra give for the ephah and the bath (22 litres), so a tenth of a homer is also about 22 litres and a homer or kor about 220; the English gives about 6 gallons, as the founder ruled for Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: {{units:22 ሊትር ያህል|የሆሜር አንድ አሥረኛ}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Litres by default, with the Hebrew measure as the alternative. The ephah and the bath are about 22 litres and the homer and the kor about 220, the values used on main; Literal keeps the Hebrew measures.

decisions.choice: {{units:लगभग 22 लीटर|होमेर का दसवाँ भाग}}
decisions.reason: Metric by default, the original measure as the alternative, as in the Pentateuch: the ephah and the bath are both about 22 litres, the homer and the kor about 220 litres, the hin about 3.7 litres. The English gives US gallons.

decisions.reason: The ephah and the bath are set equal here (m1), so both take the Pentateuch value of the ephah, about 22 litres (the homer 220 litres), metric by default with the original measure as the alternative.

records.literal_gloss: And the shekel [will be] twenty gerahs; twenty shekels, twenty-five shekels, fifteen shekels the mina will be for you.

en.L: And the shekel will be twenty gerahs; twenty shekels, twenty-five shekels [and] fifteen shekels will be your mina.
en.B: The shekel is to be twenty gerahs. Your mina is to be {{units:about 8 ounces|twenty shekels}} plus {{units:about 10 ounces|twenty-five shekels}} plus {{units:about 6 ounces|fifteen shekels}}.
en.R: A shekel must weigh twenty gerahs. A mina must weigh {{units:about 1 1/2 pounds|sixty shekels}}: twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels.

pt.L: E o siclo será de vinte geras; vinte siclos, vinte e cinco siclos [e] quinze siclos será a mina de vocês.
pt.B: O siclo deverá ser de vinte geras. A mina de vocês deverá ser de {{units:cerca de 230 gramas|vinte siclos}} mais {{units:cerca de 290 gramas|vinte e cinco siclos}} mais {{units:cerca de 170 gramas|quinze siclos}}.

es.R: Un siclo debe pesar veinte geras. Una mina debe pesar {{units:unos 690 gramos|sesenta siclos}}: veinte siclos más veinticinco siclos más quince siclos.

fr.L: Et le sicle sera de vingt guéras ; vingt sicles, vingt-cinq sicles [et] quinze sicles seront votre mine.
fr.B: Le sicle vaudra vingt guéras. Votre mine vaudra {{units:environ 230 grammes|vingt sicles}} plus {{units:environ 290 grammes|vingt-cinq sicles}} plus {{units:environ 170 grammes|quinze sicles}}.

decisions.choice: the shekel and the gerah: weights
decisions.reason: The shekel was a weight of silver of about two-fifths of an ounce (11 grams); the gerah was a twentieth of it. The same definition is given in Exodus 30:13 and Leviticus 27:25.

decisions.choice: twenty, twenty-five and fifteen shekels make the mina: sixty shekels
decisions.reason: The three amounts add up to sixty, so the mina is to be sixty shekels, about 1 1/2 pounds. The odd way of stating it may name three weights in use, or may be meant to fix the total. Elsewhere a mina could be fifty shekels.

decisions.choice: the Septuagint has different figures
decisions.reason: The Septuagint reads differently here, with a mina of fifty shekels. The translation follows the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: the shekel amounts in ounces (B); the mina as about 1 1/2 pounds (R)
decisions.reason: The definition "the shekel is twenty gerahs" is kept as it stands at every level, as in Leviticus 27:25. Balanced gives each amount in ounces (as 4:10). Readable states the total of sixty shekels (m2) and gives its weight.

decisions.choice: grams by default on the shekel of 11,5 grams, with the shekels as the alternative
decisions.reason: The Old Testament terms reckon the shekel at 11,5 grams, so twenty shekels are about 230 grams and the mina of sixty shekels (m2) about 690 grams. "Siclo" and "gera" as Leviticus 27:25 in Portuguese; the definition "vinte geras" keeps no setting, as in the English.

decisions.choice: grams for the shekel amounts (B) and for the mina of sixty shekels (R), at 11.5 g a shekel
decisions.reason: "Siếc-lơ", "ghê-ra" and "mi-na" are the published names; the shekel is reckoned at about 11.5 g, as the term sheet sets.

decisions.choice: grams (shekel about 11.5 g), with the shekels as the alternative
decisions.reason: Metric by default, as the published Swahili gives a shekel of about 11.5 g; gera and mane are the published names (Exodus 30:13; Ezra).

decisions.choice: A shekel of 11.5 g: twenty shekels 약 230그램, twenty-five 약 290그램, fifteen 약 170그램 (B); the mina of sixty shekels 약 690그램 (R)
decisions.reason: Korean converts to grams on the term sheet's 11.5 g shekel. Readable gives the total, as the English does, and still lists the three amounts in words.

decisions.choice: grams by default: 230, 290 and 170 grams (B); a mina of {{units:690 ግራም ያህል|ስድሳ ሰቅል}} (R)
decisions.reason: The shekel is worked at 11.5 grams, as on main, so the mina of sixty shekels is about 690 grams. The shekel amounts as alternatives keep Ezekiel's sum, which Readable also spells out.

decisions.choice: {{units:लगभग 230 ग्राम|बीस शेकेल}} ... (B); {{units:लगभग 700 ग्राम|साठ शेकेल}} (R)
decisions.reason: Grams by default, the shekels as the alternative, on the shekel of 11.5 g (Ezekiel 4:10). The mina here is sixty shekels, about 700 g. 'The shekel is twenty gerahs' stays as it stands at every level, as in Leviticus 27:25; माने is the mina's form in 1 Kings 10:17.

decisions.choice: сикль; гера; мина
decisions.reason: Сикль, never шекель, as the Russian Pentateuch; гера and мина as the earlier books. The definition "twenty gerahs" stays as it stands at every level, as in the English; the weights in grams use the Pentateuch's shekel of 11.5 g (B), and Readable gives the whole mina (m2).

vi.L: Đây [là] của lễ dâng riêng mà các ngươi sẽ dâng: một phần sáu ê-pha từ một hô-me lúa mì, và các ngươi sẽ dâng một phần sáu ê-pha từ một hô-me lúa mạch,
vi.B: Đây là lễ vật đặc biệt các ngươi phải dâng: {{units:khoảng 3,7 lít|một phần sáu ê-pha}} cho mỗi {{units:220 lít|hô-me}} lúa mì, và {{units:khoảng 3,7 lít|một phần sáu ê-pha}} cho mỗi {{units:220 lít|hô-me}} lúa mạch.
vi.R: Đây là lễ vật đặc biệt các ngươi phải dâng: cứ mỗi {{units:220 lít|hô-me}} lúa mì hay lúa mạch, hãy dâng {{units:khoảng 3,7 lít|một phần sáu ê-pha}}.

sw.L: Hili [ndilo] toleo mtakalotoa: sehemu ya sita ya efa kutoka homeri ya ngano, nanyi mtatoa sehemu ya sita ya efa kutoka homeri ya shayiri,
sw.B: Hii ndiyo sadaka maalum mtakayotoa: {{units:karibu lita 4|sehemu ya sita ya efa}} kutoka kila {{units:karibu lita 220|homeri moja}} ya ngano, na {{units:karibu lita 4|sehemu ya sita ya efa}} kutoka kila {{units:karibu lita 220|homeri moja}} ya shayiri.
sw.R: Hii ndiyo sadaka maalum lazima mtoe: kutoka kila {{units:karibu lita 220|homeri moja}} ya ngano au ya shayiri, toeni {{units:karibu lita 4|sehemu ya sita ya efa}}.

ko.L: 이것이 너희가 바칠 예물이다. 밀 한 호멜에서 에바의 육분의 일을, 그리고 보리 한 호멜에서 에바의 육분의 일을 너희가 바쳐야 한다.
ko.B: 너희가 바칠 특별한 예물은 이러하다. 밀은 {{units:약 220리터|한 호멜}}마다 {{units:약 3.7리터|육분의 일 에바}}씩, 보리도 {{units:약 220리터|한 호멜}}마다 {{units:약 3.7리터|육분의 일 에바}}씩 바쳐라.
ko.R: 너희가 바쳐야 할 특별한 예물은 이러하다. 밀이나 보리 {{units:약 220리터|한 호멜}}마다 {{units:약 3.7리터|육분의 일 에바}}씩 바쳐라.

am.L: የምታነሡትም የሚነሣ መባ ይህ ነው፤ ከአንድ ሆሜር ስንዴ የኢፍ አንድ ስድስተኛ፣ ከአንድ ሆሜር ገብስም የኢፍ አንድ ስድስተኛ ትሰጣላችሁ፤
am.B: የምታቀርቡት ልዩ መባ ይህ ነው፦ ከእያንዳንዱ {{units:220 ሊትር ያህል|ሆሜር}} ስንዴ {{units:3.7 ሊትር ያህል|የኢፍ አንድ ስድስተኛ}}፣ ከእያንዳንዱ {{units:220 ሊትር ያህል|ሆሜር}} ገብስም {{units:3.7 ሊትር ያህል|የኢፍ አንድ ስድስተኛ}}።
am.R: መስጠት ያለባችሁ ልዩ መባ ይህ ነው፦ ከእያንዳንዱ {{units:220 ሊትር ያህል|ሆሜር}} ስንዴ ወይም ገብስ {{units:3.7 ሊትር ያህል|የኢፍ አንድ ስድስተኛ}} ስጡ።

hi.L: यह वह भेंट [है] जो तुम चढ़ाओगे: गेहूँ के होमेर में से एपा का छठा भाग, और जौ के होमेर में से एपा का छठा भाग तुम देना,
hi.B: यह वह विशेष भेंट है जो तुम दोगे: हर {{units:लगभग 220 लीटर|होमेर}} गेहूँ में से {{units:लगभग 3.7 लीटर|एपा का छठा भाग}}, और हर {{units:लगभग 220 लीटर|होमेर}} जौ में से {{units:लगभग 3.7 लीटर|एपा का छठा भाग}}।
hi.R: यह वह विशेष भेंट है जो तुम्हें देनी है: हर {{units:लगभग 220 लीटर|होमेर}} गेहूँ या जौ में से {{units:लगभग 3.7 लीटर|एपा का छठा भाग}} देना।

ru.L: Вот возношение, которое вы будете возносить: шестая часть ефы от хомера пшеницы, и давайте шестую часть ефы от хомера ячменя,
ru.B: Вот особое приношение, которое вы должны давать: {{units:около 3,7 литра|шестую часть ефы}} {{units:с каждых 220 литров|с каждого хомера}} пшеницы и {{units:около 3,7 литра|шестую часть ефы}} {{units:с каждых 220 литров|с каждого хомера}} ячменя.
ru.R: Вот особое приношение, которое вы должны давать: {{units:с каждых 220 литров|с каждого хомера}} пшеницы или ячменя отдавайте {{units:около 3,7 литра|шестую часть ефы}}.

uk.L: Це приношення, яке ви принесете: шосту частину ефи з хомера пшениці, і дасте шосту частину ефи з хомера ячменю,
uk.B: Ось особливе приношення, яке ви маєте давати: {{units:близько 3,7 літра|шосту частину ефи}} {{units:з кожних 220 літрів|з кожного хомера}} пшениці і {{units:близько 3,7 літра|шосту частину ефи}} {{units:з кожних 220 літрів|з кожного хомера}} ячменю.
uk.R: Ось особливе приношення, яке ви мусите давати: {{units:з кожних 220 літрів|з кожного хомера}} пшениці чи ячменю давайте {{units:близько 3,7 літра|шосту частину ефи}}.

decisions.choice: a sixth of an ephah from a homer: one part in sixty
decisions.reason: A homer is ten ephahs, so a sixth of an ephah is a sixtieth of the grain. These gifts go to the prince for the offerings (verses 16-17).

decisions.choice: the contribution: the people's gift for the offerings
decisions.reason: The same word as the land of verse 1, here used for gifts of produce (as 44:30).

decisions.choice: contribution (L); special offering (B, R)
decisions.reason: Here *terumah* is a gift of produce, as in 44:30.

decisions.choice: {{units:about a gallon|a sixth of an ephah}}; {{units:6 bushels|homer}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: On the ephah of about 6 gallons (verse 11); the homer of grain is given as about 6 bushels (see verse 11).

decisions.choice: toleo (Literal); sadaka maalum (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Here terumah is the people's gift for the offerings, so Balanced and Readable say "special offering", as the English.

decisions.choice: "የሚነሣ መባ" (L); "ልዩ መባ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: *Terumah* as a gift of grain, oil and sheep: Literal keeps the word of 45:1; Balanced and Readable say "a special offering", as the English.

decisions.choice: {{units:3.7 ሊትር ያህል|የኢፍ አንድ ስድስተኛ}}; {{units:220 ሊትር ያህል|ሆሜር}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: A sixth of a 22-litre ephah is about 3.7 litres; the homer about 220 litres, as on main.

decisions.choice: भेंट (L); विशेष भेंट (B, R)
decisions.reason: Here terumah is a gift of produce for the offerings (m2), not land, so Balanced and Readable say विशेष भेंट rather than the विशेष भाग of 45:1, as the English moves from 'special portion' to 'special offering'.

decisions.choice: возношение (L); особое приношение (B, R)
decisions.reason: Here *terumah* is a gift of produce, not land, so Balanced and Readable use приношение (as Exodus 25:2 at Balanced) rather than the land word участок.

decisions.choice: {{units:около 3,7 литра|шестую часть ефы}}; {{units:с каждых 220 литров|с каждого хомера}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: A sixth of a 22-litre ephah, and the homer as 220 litres (the Pentateuch values). The preposition and каждый sit inside each option so that both read grammatically.

source.text: וְחֹ֨ק הַשֶּׁ֜מֶן הַבַּ֣ת הַשֶּׁ֗מֶן מַעְשַׂ֤ר הַבַּת֙ מִן־הַכֹּ֔ר עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת הַבַּתִּ֖ים חֹ֑מֶר כִּֽי־עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת הַבַּתִּ֖ים חֹֽמֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: And the portion of the oil, the bath of the oil, a tenth of the bath from the kor, ten baths [are] a homer, for ten baths [are] a homer.

en.L: and the portion of oil, measured by the bath, a tenth of a bath from each kor (ten baths [are] a homer, for ten baths [are] a homer);
en.B: The portion of oil, measured by the bath, is to be {{units:about 2 1/2 quarts|a tenth of a bath}} from every {{units:60 gallons|kor}} (a kor is ten baths, the same as a homer, for ten baths make a homer).
en.R: Of olive oil, give {{units:about 2 1/2 quarts|a tenth of a bath}} from every {{units:60 gallons|kor}}. A kor holds ten baths, the same as a homer.

pt.L: e a porção de azeite, medida pelo bato, a décima parte de um bato de cada coro (dez batos [são] um hômer, pois dez batos [são] um hômer);
pt.B: A porção de azeite, medida pelo bato, deverá ser {{units:cerca de 2,2 litros|a décima parte de um bato}} de cada {{units:220 litros|coro}} (um coro tem dez batos, o mesmo que um hômer, pois dez batos fazem um hômer).
pt.R: Do azeite, deem {{units:cerca de 2,2 litros|a décima parte de um bato}} de cada {{units:220 litros|coro}}. Um coro contém dez batos, o mesmo que um hômer.

es.L: y la porción del aceite, medida por el bato, la décima parte de un bato de cada coro (diez batos [son] un homer, porque diez batos [son] un homer);
es.B: La porción de aceite, medida por el bato, será {{units:unos 2,2 litros|la décima parte de un bato}} de cada {{units:220 litros|coro}} (un coro tiene diez batos, lo mismo que un homer, porque diez batos hacen un homer).
es.R: Del aceite de oliva, {{plural_you:den|dad}} {{units:unos 2,2 litros|la décima parte de un bato}} de cada {{units:220 litros|coro}}. Un coro contiene diez batos, lo mismo que un homer.

fr.L: et la part d’huile, mesurée au bath : un dixième de bath par kor (dix baths [font] un homer, car dix baths [font] un homer) ;
fr.B: Pour l’huile, mesurée au bath, la part sera d’{{units:environ 2 litres|un dixième de bath}} sur {{units:environ 220 litres|un kor}} (le kor vaut dix baths, comme le homer, car dix baths font un homer).
fr.R: Pour l’huile d’olive, donnez {{units:environ 2 litres|un dixième de bath}} sur {{units:environ 220 litres|un kor}}. Un kor contient dix baths, comme un homer.

vi.L: và phần dầu, đong bằng bát, một phần mười bát từ mỗi cô-rơ (mười bát [là] một hô-me, vì mười bát [là] một hô-me);
vi.B: Phần dầu, đong bằng bát, phải là {{units:khoảng 2,2 lít|một phần mười bát}} cho mỗi {{units:220 lít|cô-rơ}} (một cô-rơ là mười bát, bằng một hô-me, vì mười bát là một hô-me).
vi.R: Về dầu ô-liu, hãy dâng {{units:khoảng 2,2 lít|một phần mười bát}} cho mỗi {{units:220 lít|cô-rơ}}. Một cô-rơ chứa mười bát, bằng một hô-me.

sw.L: na fungu la mafuta, kwa kipimo cha bathi, sehemu ya kumi ya bathi kutoka kila kori (bathi kumi [ni] homeri, kwa maana bathi kumi [ni] homeri);
sw.B: Fungu la mafuta, likipimwa kwa bathi, litakuwa {{units:karibu lita 2|sehemu ya kumi ya bathi}} kutoka kila {{units:karibu lita 220|kori moja}} (kori ni bathi kumi, sawa na homeri, kwa maana bathi kumi ni homeri).
sw.R: Kwa mafuta ya zeituni, toeni {{units:karibu lita 2|sehemu ya kumi ya bathi}} kutoka kila {{units:karibu lita 220|kori moja}}. Kori moja ni bathi kumi, sawa na homeri moja.

ko.L: 그리고 기름의 몫은 밧으로 [재어], 한 고르에서 밧의 십분의 일이다. 열 밧이 한 호멜이니, 열 밧이 한 호멜이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 기름의 몫은 밧으로 재어 {{units:약 220리터|한 고르}}마다 {{units:약 2.2리터|십분의 일 밧}}씩이다. 한 고르는 열 밧으로, 한 호멜과 같다. 열 밧이 한 호멜이기 때문이다.
ko.R: 올리브기름은 {{units:약 220리터|한 고르}}마다 {{units:약 2.2리터|십분의 일 밧}}씩 바쳐라. 한 고르는 열 밧으로, 한 호멜과 같다.

am.L: የዘይቱም ድርሻ በባዶስ ተሰፍሮ ከእያንዳንዱ ቆሮስ የባዶስ አንድ አሥረኛ [ይሆናል] (አሥር ባዶስ አንድ ሆሜር [ነው]፤ አሥር ባዶስ አንድ ሆሜር ነውና)፤
am.B: በባዶስ የሚሰፈረው የዘይቱ ድርሻ ከእያንዳንዱ {{units:220 ሊትር ያህል|ቆሮስ}} {{units:2.2 ሊትር ያህል|የባዶስ አንድ አሥረኛ}} ይሁን (አንድ ቆሮስ አሥር ባዶስ ነው፤ ይህም ከሆሜር ጋር እኩል ነው፤ አሥር ባዶስ አንድ ሆሜር ነውና)።
am.R: ከወይራ ዘይቱም ከእያንዳንዱ {{units:220 ሊትር ያህል|ቆሮስ}} {{units:2.2 ሊትር ያህል|የባዶስ አንድ አሥረኛ}} ስጡ። አንድ ቆሮስ አሥር ባዶስ ይይዛል፤ ይህም ከሆሜር ጋር እኩል ነው።

hi.L: और तेल का भाग, बत से नापा हुआ, हर कोर में से बत का दसवाँ भाग (दस बत का होमेर [होता है], क्योंकि दस बत का होमेर [होता है]);
hi.B: तेल का भाग, बत से नापकर, हर {{units:लगभग 220 लीटर|कोर}} में से {{units:लगभग 2.2 लीटर|बत का दसवाँ भाग}} हो (कोर दस बत का होता है, होमेर के बराबर, क्योंकि दस बत का होमेर होता है)।
hi.R: जैतून के तेल के हर {{units:लगभग 220 लीटर|कोर}} में से {{units:लगभग 2.2 लीटर|बत का दसवाँ भाग}} देना। एक कोर में दस बत होते हैं, उतने ही जितने एक होमेर में।

ru.L: и установленное для масла — батом масла: десятая часть бата от кора (десять батов — хомер, потому что десять батов — хомер);
ru.B: Доля масла, отмеряемая батом, — {{units:около 2,2 литра|десятая часть бата}} {{units:с каждых 220 литров|с каждого кора}} (кор — это десять батов, как и хомер, потому что десять батов составляют хомер).
ru.R: Оливкового масла отдавайте {{units:около 2,2 литра|десятую часть бата}} {{units:с каждых 220 литров|с каждого кора}}. В коре десять батов, столько же, сколько в хомере.

uk.L: і частку олії, мірою бат, — десяту частину бату з кожного кору (десять батів — хомер, бо десять батів — хомер);
uk.B: Частка олії, мірою бат, має бути {{units:близько 2,2 літра|десята частина бату}} {{units:з кожних 220 літрів|з кожного кору}} (кор — це десять батів, як і хомер, бо десять батів становлять хомер).
uk.R: Оливкової олії давайте {{units:близько 2,2 літра|десяту частину бату}} {{units:з кожних 220 літрів|з кожного кору}}. Кор містить десять батів, як і хомер.

decisions.choice: the kor: a large measure, the same as the homer
decisions.reason: The kor is used for large amounts of grain and oil (1 Kings 5:2, 25). It held ten baths, the same as a homer.

decisions.choice: ten baths are a homer, for ten baths are a homer: a repeated note
decisions.reason: The phrase is said twice, perhaps for emphasis, perhaps by a copyist's slip. One part in a hundred of the oil is to be given.

decisions.choice: {{units:about 2 1/2 quarts|a tenth of a bath}}; {{units:60 gallons|kor}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: On the bath of about 6 gallons (verse 11).

decisions.choice: coro
decisions.reason: The kor (m1) in its Portuguese form "coro", equal to the homer, 220 litres, as the Old Testament terms give it.

decisions.choice: {{units:2.2 ሊትር ያህል|የባዶስ አንድ አሥረኛ}}; {{units:220 ሊትር ያህል|ቆሮስ}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: A tenth of a 22-litre bath is 2.2 litres; the kor (ቆሮስ, as in 1 Kings on main) is ten baths, about 220 litres.

decisions.choice: {{units:около 2,2 литра|десятая часть бата}}; {{units:с каждых 220 литров|с каждого кора}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: The bath equals the ephah (verse 11), so a tenth of it is about 2.2 litres; the kor, like the homer, is 220 litres.

source.text: וְשֶׂה־אַחַ֨ת מִן־הַצֹּ֤אן מִן־הַמָּאתַ֨יִם֙ מִמַּשְׁקֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמִנְחָ֖ה וּלְעוֹלָ֣ה וְלִשְׁלָמִ֑ים לְכַפֵּ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And one sheep from the flock, from the two hundred, from [the] well-watered [land] of Israel, for grain offering and for burnt offering and for peace offerings, to make atonement for them, declares [the] Lord Yahweh.

en.L: and one sheep from the flock out of every 200, from the well-watered pastures of Israel, for the grain offering, the burnt offering and the peace offerings, to make atonement for them, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: and one sheep out of every 200 from the well-watered pastures of Israel. These will be used for grain offerings, burnt offerings and peace offerings, to make atonement on the people's behalf, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Give one sheep out of every 200 from the good pastures of Israel. These gifts will be used for the grain offerings, the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, to make atonement for the people, says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.

pt.L: e uma ovelha do rebanho, de cada duzentas, das pastagens bem regadas de Israel, para a oferta de cereal, e para o holocausto, e para os sacrifícios de comunhão, para fazer expiação por eles, declara o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}.
pt.B: e uma ovelha de cada duzentas das pastagens bem regadas de Israel. Elas serão usadas para as ofertas de cereal, os holocaustos e os sacrifícios de comunhão, para fazer expiação pelo povo, declara o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}.
pt.R: Deem uma ovelha de cada duzentas das boas pastagens de Israel. Essas ofertas serão usadas para as ofertas de cereal, os holocaustos e os sacrifícios de comunhão, para fazer expiação pelo povo, diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}.

es.L: y una oveja del rebaño de cada 200, de los pastos bien regados de Israel, para la ofrenda de cereal, el holocausto y los sacrificios de paz, para hacer expiación por ellos, declara el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.B: y una oveja de cada 200 de los pastos bien regados de Israel. Esto servirá para las ofrendas de cereal, los holocaustos y los sacrificios de paz, para hacer expiación por el pueblo, afirma el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} una oveja de cada 200 de los buenos pastos de Israel. Estas ofrendas servirán para las ofrendas de cereal, los holocaustos y los sacrificios de paz, para hacer expiación por el pueblo, dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: et une brebis du troupeau sur 200, des pâturages bien arrosés d’Israël, pour l’offrande végétale, l’holocauste et les sacrifices de communion, pour faire l’expiation pour eux, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: et une brebis sur 200, prise dans les pâturages bien arrosés d’Israël. Ces dons serviront aux offrandes végétales, aux holocaustes et aux sacrifices de communion, pour faire l’expiation en faveur du peuple, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Donnez un mouton sur 200, pris dans les bons pâturages d’Israël. Ces dons serviront pour les offrandes végétales, les holocaustes et les sacrifices de communion, pour faire l’expiation pour le peuple, dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.

vi.L: và một con chiên từ bầy, trong mỗi 200 con, từ các đồng cỏ được tưới nhuần của Y-sơ-ra-ên, để làm tế lễ ngũ cốc, của lễ thiêu và tế lễ bình an, để chuộc tội cho họ, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: và một con chiên trong mỗi 200 con từ các đồng cỏ được tưới nhuần của Y-sơ-ra-ên. Những lễ vật ấy sẽ dùng làm tế lễ ngũ cốc, của lễ thiêu và tế lễ bình an, để chuộc tội cho dân chúng, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Hãy dâng một con chiên trong mỗi 200 con từ các đồng cỏ tốt của Y-sơ-ra-ên. Những lễ vật này sẽ được dùng làm tế lễ ngũ cốc, của lễ thiêu và tế lễ bình an, để chuộc tội cho dân chúng, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

sw.L: na kondoo mmoja wa kundi katika kila mia mbili, kutoka malisho yaliyonyweshwa vizuri ya Israeli, kwa ajili ya sadaka ya nafaka, sadaka ya kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani, ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yao, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: na kondoo mmoja katika kila kondoo mia mbili kutoka malisho yenye maji mengi ya Israeli. Hivi vitatumika kwa sadaka za nafaka, sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani, ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya watu, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Toeni kondoo mmoja katika kila kondoo mia mbili kutoka malisho mazuri ya Israeli. Zawadi hizi zitatumika kwa sadaka za nafaka, sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani, ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya watu, anasema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘의 물이 넉넉한 목장에서 양 떼 200마리 가운데서 한 마리를 곡식 제물과 번제물과 화목제물로 [바쳐], 그들을 위하여 속죄하게 하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 이스라엘의 물이 넉넉한 목장에서 기르는 양 200마리마다 한 마리씩 바쳐라. 이것들은 곡식 제물과 번제물과 화목제물로 쓰여 백성을 위하여 속죄하는 데 쓰일 것이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.
ko.R: 이스라엘의 좋은 목장에서 기르는 양 200마리마다 한 마리씩 바쳐라. 이 예물들은 곡식 제물과 번제물과 화목제물로 쓰여, 백성을 위하여 속죄하는 데 쓰일 것이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.

am.L: ከመንጋውም ከእያንዳንዱ 200 አንድ በግ ከእስራኤል ውኃ ከጠገበው ግጦሽ፣ ለእህል ቁርባን፣ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና ለኅብረት መሥዋዕቶች፣ ለእነርሱም ለማስተስረይ [ይሁን]፤ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.B: ከእስራኤል ውኃ ከጠገበው ግጦሽ ከእያንዳንዱ 200 በጎች አንድ በግ ስጡ። እነዚህ ለሕዝቡ ለማስተስረይ ለእህል ቁርባን፣ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና ለኅብረት መሥዋዕት ይውላሉ፤ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: ከእስራኤል ለም ግጦሽ ከእያንዳንዱ 200 በጎች አንድ በግ ስጡ። እነዚህ ስጦታዎች ለሕዝቡ ለማስተስረይ ለእህል ቁርባን፣ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና ለኅብረት መሥዋዕት ይውላሉ፤ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: और भेड़-बकरियों में से हर 200 में से एक भेड़, इस्राएल की सिंची हुई चरागाहों में से, अन्नबलि और होमबलि और मेलबलियों के लिए, कि उनके लिए प्रायश्चित किया जाए, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.B: और इस्राएल की हरी-भरी चरागाहों में से हर 200 में से एक भेड़। ये अन्नबलियों, होमबलियों और मेलबलियों के काम आएँगी, कि लोगों के लिए प्रायश्चित किया जाए, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.R: इस्राएल की अच्छी चरागाहों में से हर 200 भेड़ों में से एक भेड़ देना। ये भेंटें अन्नबलियों, होमबलियों और मेलबलियों के काम आएँगी, ताकि लोगों के लिए प्रायश्चित हो, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: и одну овцу из стада, из двухсот, с орошаемых [пастбищ] Израиля — для хлебного приношения, и для всесожжения, и для мирных жертв, чтобы совершить умилостивление за них, — слово Владыки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: и одну овцу с каждых двухсот с хорошо орошаемых пастбищ Израиля. Это пойдёт на хлебные приношения, всесожжения и мирные жертвы, чтобы совершить умилостивление за народ, — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Отдавайте одну овцу из каждых двухсот с хороших пастбищ Израиля. Эти дары пойдут на хлебные приношения, всесожжения и мирные жертвы, чтобы совершить умилостивление за народ, — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

uk.L: і одну вівцю з отари з кожних двохсот, з добре зрошених пасовищ Ізраїлю, на хлібну жертву, всепалення і мирні жертви, щоб звершити очищення за них, говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: і одну вівцю з кожних двохсот з добре зрошених пасовищ Ізраїлю. Їх використовуватимуть для хлібних жертв, всепалень і мирних жертв, щоб звершити очищення за народ, говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Давайте одну вівцю з кожних двохсот з добрих пасовищ Ізраїлю. Ці дари використовуватимуть для хлібних жертв, всепалень і мирних жертв, щоб звершити очищення за народ, каже Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: the well-watered land of Israel: the good pastures
decisions.reason: The word means a watered place, a place where flocks drink. Some read it as "the families of Israel", from a similar word in the Septuagint.

decisions.choice: to make atonement for them: the offerings restore the people's relationship with the LORD
decisions.reason: Not only the sin offering but all the offerings, brought on behalf of the whole people, cover their sin and keep them acceptable to the LORD (verse 17).

decisions.choice: "የእህል ቁርባን", "የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት", "የኅብረት መሥዋዕት", "ማስተስረይ"
decisions.reason: The offerings and atonement keep the words of Leviticus and Numbers on main; so do the sin offering ("የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት"), the drink offering ("የመጠጥ ቁርባን") and the guilt offering ("የበደል መሥዋዕት") in chapters 45-46.

en.B: All the people of the land are to give this special offering to the prince in Israel.
en.R: All the people of the land must give these special offerings to the ruler of Israel.

pt.L: Todo o povo da terra [dará] esta contribuição para o príncipe em Israel.
pt.B: Todo o povo da terra deverá dar essa oferta especial ao príncipe em Israel.
pt.R: Todo o povo da terra deve dar essas ofertas especiais ao governante de Israel.

es.L: Todo el pueblo de la tierra [dará] esta contribución al príncipe en Israel.
es.B: Todo el pueblo de la tierra dará esta ofrenda especial al príncipe en Israel.
es.R: Todo el pueblo de la tierra tiene que dar estas ofrendas especiales al gobernante de Israel.

fr.L: Tout le peuple du pays [donnera] cette contribution au prince en Israël.
